tools.name: Repository Manager
tools.description: Plan and apply the hub side of connecting a new or existing repository, generate its connector kit, and register its snapshot endpoint.

tools.name: Snapshot Sync
tools.description: Fetch bounded public repository snapshots, validate identity and transport, and expose sync health.

tools.name: Hub Builder
tools.description: Validate connected snapshots and aggregate repository data, health, workspace tools, and settings into the static command-center model.

tools.name: Workbench Editor
tools.description: VS Code-inspired local scratch/config editor. Content stays in browser localStorage unless explicitly copied into an authorized workflow.

tools.name: Python Debug Adapter
tools.description: Defines a bounded launch/debug request contract for a trusted runner. Static GitHub Pages never executes local Python itself.

tools.name: Open in VS Code for Web
tools.description: Open a connected GitHub repository in Microsoft's browser-based VS Code surface for full file navigation and editing under the user's GitHub authorization.

tools.name: Command Palette
tools.description: Keyboard-first navigation and workbench command discovery.
